assessment: This study generated an important single-cell transcriptome dataset using young/aged hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells obtained from normal individuals and those with MDS. The new resource provides a convincing dataset to understand a unique transcriptional landscape in elderly individuals, compared to young individuals, proving the hematopoietic aging at a transcriptome level. This manuscript will be of interest to readers in the field of hematopoiesis and associated diseases, aging, and single-cell RNA sequencing.
